text: CUPRA is one of the ten brands of the Volkswagen Group; its own website is operated by SEAT, S.A.U.
short: CUPRA is a Volkswagen Group brand (one of its ten car brands).

source.name: Volkswagen Group (volkswagen-group.com): Group page
source.quote: The Group comprises ten brands from five European countries: Volkswagen, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, ŠKODA, SEAT, CUPRA, Audi, Lamborghini, Bentley, Porsche and Ducati.

additionalSources.name: CUPRA (cupra.com): site footer
additionalSources.note: CUPRA's own website footer states '© SEAT, S.A.U. 2026 - All rights reserved. Website operated by SEAT, S.A.U.' and carries a footer link labelled 'Part of Volkswagen Group' pointing to volkswagen-group.com.
